complex_analysis/injective.pdf.title: Injective Entire Functions
complex_analysis/injective.pdf.description: A proof that every injective entire function is affine, using Rouché's theorem, Cauchy estimates, singularities at infinity, and the open mapping theorem.

number_theory/arth_top.pdf.title: Arithmetic Topology on the Integers
number_theory/arth_top.pdf.description: Constructs a topology on the integers from arithmetic progressions, proves its basic sets are clopen, and derives the infinitude of primes topologically.

number_theory/gaussian.pdf.title: Gaussian Integers and Sums of Two Squares
number_theory/gaussian.pdf.description: Studies norms, units, conjugation, and prime splitting in the Gaussian integers, culminating in the criterion for representing an integer as a sum of two squares.

number_theory/phi.pdf.title: Euler's Totient Function
number_theory/phi.pdf.description: Develops multiplicativity and the prime-factor formula for Euler's totient function, then proves finiteness of its fibers and divisibility under divisors.

topology/project1.pdf.title: Noetherian and Irreducible Spaces
topology/project1.pdf.description: Explores hereditary and compactness properties of Noetherian spaces, irreducibility, finite irreducible decompositions, and examples inspired by prime numbers.

topology/baire.pdf.title: The Baire Category Theorem
topology/baire.pdf.description: Proves that a countable intersection of open dense subsets of a complete metric space is dense, using nested balls and a Cauchy-sequence construction.

topology/sine_top.pdf.title: The Topologist's Sine Curve
topology/sine_top.pdf.description: Analyzes the classical topologist's sine curve, proving connectedness through closure while showing that adjoining the origin does not produce a path-connected space.

topology/cauchy_sequences.pdf.title: Completion of Metric Spaces
topology/cauchy_sequences.pdf.description: Constructs the completion of a metric space from equivalence classes of Cauchy sequences, proves completeness and density of the canonical embedding, and examines completeness under homeomorphism.

topology/equicontenuity.pdf.title: Baire Category and Incomplete Normed Spaces
topology/equicontenuity.pdf.description: Uses the Baire category theorem to obtain local uniform boundedness for a pointwise bounded family of continuous functions, then proves a natural normed space of polynomials is incomplete.

topology/tube_lemma.pdf.title: The Tube Lemma and Closed Projections
topology/tube_lemma.pdf.description: Proves the tube lemma, closedness of projections with compact factors, a closed-graph criterion for continuity, and positive separation of disjoint closed sets when one is compact.

topology/urysohn_theorem.pdf.title: Separation Axioms and Normal Spaces
topology/urysohn_theorem.pdf.description: Studies hereditary separation properties, Hausdorff quotient spaces formed by collapsing a closed set, and the theorem that regular second-countable spaces are normal.
